This announcement will also be available on the website of the Company at https://investors.ixigo.com/. This is for your information and records. Thank you, For Le Travenues Technology Limited Suresh Kumar Bhutani (Group General Counsel, Company Secretary & Compliance Officer) ixigo Delivers All-time High PAT of Rs.63.42 Cr in Q2 FY27 Hotels Business Emerges As A Significant Growth Driver for ixigo ● Q2 FY27 GTV stood at Rs. 5,304.47 Cr (+22% YoY), Revenue from Operations at Rs. 320.96 Cr (+13% YoY), and Contribution Margin at Rs 124.86 Cr (+14% YoY) ● Q2 FY27 Profit After Tax (PAT) at Rs. 63.42 Cr aided by partial sale of stake in Freshbus; Profit Before Tax (PBT) grew 37% YoY (excluding ESOP expense of Rs. 26.9 Cr. for Q2 FY26) ● Hotels emerged as ixigo’s fastest-growing business line by GTV, reaching Rs. 111.34 Cr, up 159% YoY, with room nights booked (net of cancellations) crossing 4.7 Lakhs for the quarter, growing 295% YoY. Gurugram, India, 17 October 2026: Le Travenues Technology Limited (NSE: IXIGO, BSE: 544192), India’s leading AI-based travel platform, today announced its standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. ixigo delivered resilient growth in Q2 FY27, supported by its diversified multimodal travel business. Gross Transaction Value (GTV) grew 22% YoY to Rs. 5,304.47 Cr, while Revenue from Operations increased 13% YoY to Rs. 320.96 Cr. Contribution Margin rose 14% YoY to Rs. 124.86 Cr. This is the first quarter ixigo has started disclosing Hotels as a separate line of business. Hotels has emerged as ixigo’s fastest-growing line of business with GTV growth of +159% YoY, Revenue growth of +528%, with a 12%+ gross take rate. 86%+ of bookings came from ixigo’s own captive users. The business crossed approximately 4.7 lakh room nights in Q2 FY27, making it one of the fastest growing hotel OTAs in India. Hotel inventory stood at 70,000+ properties in India, including 12,000+ directly contracted properties across 1,100 towns. Flight and Bus led the quarter with GTV growth of 37% and 32% YoY, respectively. ixigo expanded its distribution by powering train bookings on Uber, alongside its existing bus integration, while food delivery through Zoop and Swiggy now services over 290 railway stations. Higher airfares and limited availability of confirmed train tickets continued to support intercity bus demand growth, complemented by investments in customer experience and deeper supply expansion. Gujarat India ArMee Infotech Limited | PRESS RELEASE FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE • Ahmedabad • 17 October 2026 ArMee Infotech Delivers Strong Profitability Growth in Q1 FY27; Standalone PAT Rises 192% YoY Consolidated EBITDA more than doubles as the Company strengthens operational performance and advances its renewable energy strategy. Key Highlights  Standalone revenue from operations at ₹273.27 crore, up 1.10% YoY.  Standalone EBITDA rose 64.61% to ₹7.72 crore; margin improved to 2.83%.  Standalone PAT grew 191.58% to ₹2.77 crore.  Consolidated EBITDA rose 128.62% to ₹6.95 crore; PAT turned positive at ₹1.82 crore.  Subsequent developments: ₹300 crore IPO, 250 MW / 500 MWh BESS award and new renewable energy subsidiary. Ahmedabad, October 17, 2026: ArMee Infotech Limited (ARMEE), an infrastructure solutions company operating across IT infrastructure, managed services and renewable energy, today announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026. The Company reported improved profitability in Q1 FY27 despite modest revenue growth. Standalone revenue from operations rose to ₹273.27 crore from ₹270.29 crore a year earlier. EBITDA grew 64.61% to ₹7.72 crore, with EBITDA margin expanding to 2.83% from 1.74%. Standalone PAT increased 191.58% to ₹2.77 crore. On a consolidated basis, revenue from operations increased 1.66% to ₹275.79 crore. EBITDA rose 128.62% to ₹6.95 crore and EBITDA margin improved to 2.52% from 1.12%. Consolidated PAT was ₹1.82 crore, compared with a loss of ₹0.35 crore in Q1 FY26. The performance is encouraging in the context of the Company’s exposure to government, PSU and institutional procurement cycles, where execution and revenue recognition may be weighted towards later quarters of the financial year. Commenting on the Q2FY27 results, Mr. Vikas Oberoi, Chairman & Managing Director, Oberoi Realty, said, “The demand in India for real estate continues to be driven by a preference for quality, brand credibility and execution, with established developers and proven delivery track records continuing to attract sustained interest. In the last quarter, our residential, commercial, retail and hospitality businesses continued to deliver steady performance, reflecting the strength of our diversified portfolio. Our entry into NCR with our project Three Sixty North marked an important milestone in Oberoi Realty’s journey. The Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR) market continues to demonstrate its depth and resilience, and we remain encouraged by demand trends as we enter the festive period. We continue to take a strategic approach to growth, with a focus on executing our existing developments while pursuing opportunities that are aligned with our long-term vision.” Awards and Recognition: • Prego at The Westin was featured in the International Hospitality Council London & IIHM Hospitality Honours List 2026 under the Restaurants category. • Oberoi Realty was recognised among the Top Listed Real Estate Companies 2026 by CWAB 3.0. • Oberoi Realty was recognised among the Fastest Growing Real Estate Companies of 2026 – Large Category by CWAB 3.0. • Oberoi Realty received the

Tower, Dalal Street, Mumbai – 400 001 Bandra(E), Mumbai – 400 051 Sub: DLF Press Release Dear Sir/ Madam, In compliance with Regulation 30 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, kindly find enclosed herewith Press Release pertaining to ‘DLF announces Financial Results for Q2FY27’. This is for your kind information and record please. Thanking you, Yours faithfully, For DLF Limited R. P. Punjani Company Secretary Encl.: As above Regd. Office: DLF Shopping Mall, 3rd Floor, Arjun Marg, DLF City, Phase-I, Gurugram -122 002, Haryana (India) CIN: L70101HR1963PLC002484; Website: www.dlf.in PRESS RELEASE DLF announces Financial Results for Q2FY27 Operating Cash flow of Rs 1,858 crore further reinforces underlying business strength Net profit at Rs 1,301 crore, y-o-y growth of 11% New Delhi, October 16, 2026 DLF Limited delivered a strong Q2FY27 performance, combining resilient demand, disciplined execution and robust cash generation. The results reinforce the strength of DLF’s operating platform, capital position and ability to create sustainable long-term value. Financial Highlights for Q2FY27 – DLF Limited (Consolidated)  Consolidated Revenue stood at Rs 2,298 crore  Gross margins at 47%  EBITDA stood at Rs 1,060 crore  Net Profit Rs 1,301 crore  Operating cash flow of Rs 1,858 crore Financial Highlights for Q2FY27 – DLF Cyber City Developers Limited (Consolidated)  Consolidated Revenue stood at Rs 2,014 crore  EBITDA stood at Rs 1,537 crore, y-o-y growth of 9%  Net Profit at Rs 752 crore, y-o-y growth of 17% New sales bookings stood at Rs 3,800 crore during the quarter. The Aureva in Gurugram, DLF’s curated luxury retirement housing address, witnessed a complete sell out underscoring strong demand for such differentiated offerings. Our super-luxury offering - The Dahlias, continues to attract strong demand from our discerning customers. DLF’s brand leadership, deep market presence and defined strategy provide strong visibility on its stated medium-term growth goals. Operating cash flow was Rs 1,858 crore, marked yet another quarter of sustained cash generation in the business. The net cash position stood at Rs 15,084 crore despite a significant dividend outflow of Rs 1,980 crore Our rental portfolio, spanning approximately 50 msf, continues to demonstrate robust operating strength with industry-leading occupancy. A strong operational portfolio, marquee destinations currently under development along with an identified pipeline have laid down a strong foundation to deliver steady and sustainable long-term growth across our rental business. With a significant land bank, a robust launch pipeline across development and rental businesses, a strengthened balance sheet and consistent cash flow generation, DLF is well positioned to capitalize on the structural upcycle in the sector. We remain focused on delivering sustained, profitable growth and long-term value for all stakeholders. About DLF DLF is India's leading real estate developer and has close to eight decades of track record of sustained growth, customer satisfaction, and innovation. DL

In India, this transition presents a significant opportunity to build scalable, cost- effective and application-specific solutions that support OEMs across an expanding range of vehicle segments. Recognising this evolving landscape, Varroc Engineering Limited (VARROC| 541578 | INE665L01035), a global automotive technology company, and Forsee Power SA, France (FR0014005SB3 – ALFOR), a specialist in smart battery systems, to enter into a joint venture to expand their electric mobility portfolio and combine their complementary capabilities to develop advanced battery-pack solutions. As part of the transaction, Varroc will acquire a 45% equity stake in Forsee Power India, Forsee Power’s Indian subsidiary focused on battery-pack systems and exercise management and operational control on the entity. The joint venture is proposed to operate in India subject to applicable regulatory and corporate approvals. Varroc will also subscribe to Optionally Convertible Redeemable Preference Shares (OCPRS) to support the joint venture. The joint venture will initially focus on battery packs for three-wheelers, with a roadmap to address two-wheelers, light commercial vehicles, buses, trucks, off- highway and industrial vehicles. Commenting on the partnership, Arjun Jain, Whole Time Director & CEO – Business I, Varroc, said: “Electric mobility is both evolving and growing rapidly, thus creating new opportunities and new requirements for the automotive industry. Through this evolution we believe OEMs will need partners who can anticipate changes and translate them into reliable, cost-effective solutions at scale. Our partnership with Forsee Power brings together complementary strengths in battery-system technology, automotive engineering, manufacturing and customer relationships. GDV to the Project Pipeline Mumbai, 15th October 2026 Sri Lotus Developers & Realty Limited, a leading Mumbai-based developer of luxury and ultra luxury residential and commercial properties in Mumbai, with a strong focus in redevelopment & joint development projects announced its unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September 2026. H1 FY27 has been a defining period for Sri Lotus, as the Company expands its footprint across Mumbai’s most sought-after micro-markets while maintaining the financial discipline that distinguishes it. Successful project launches, new redevelopment wins and steady demand for premium homes have together driven growth alongside industry-leading profitability. With a net debt-free balance sheet and a well-defined launch calendar for H2, the Company enters the second half with strong momentum. KEY BUSINESS & FINANCIAL UPDATES ❖ Pre-sales momentum: Q2 FY27 pre-sales rose 83% YoY to INR 470 Crs, reflecting sustained demand for the Company’s premium offerings ❖ Pipeline additions: Three new projects secured in Q2, Lotus Supremus (Juhu), Lotus Empressa (Shivaji Park, Dadar West), Lotus Stellar (Versova) and additional area secured for Lotus Insignia which together adds INR 2,700-2,800 Crs of GDV ❖ H2 FY27 launches: Four projects, Lotus Sky Plaza, Lotus Portofino, Lotus Odyssey and Lotus Aurelia are lined up with a combined estimated GDV of ~INR 3,500-4,000 Crs, positioning the Company well to meet its FY27 guidance KEY FINANCIAL HIGHLIGHTS for Q2 FY27 ❖ Pre-sales grew 83% YoY to ₹470 crore from ₹257 crore. ❖ Total Revenue grew 53% YoY to ₹269 crore from ₹176 crore ❖ EBITDA grew 113% YoY to ₹107 crore from ₹50 crore. PRESS RELEASE OHL ANNOUNCES Q2 AND H1 FY 2026-2027 FINANCIAL RESULTS MUMBAI, OCTOBER 15, 2026: Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) reported its results for the second quarter and half year ending September 30, 2026. OPERATING REVENUE OPERATING EBITDA PROFIT AFTER TAX Q2 FY 2026 -2027 INR 117 Cr INR 27 Cr INR 12 Cr Q2 FY 2025 -2026 INR 110 Cr INR 26 Cr INR 13 Cr H1 FY 2026 -2027 INR 228 Cr INR 50 Cr INR 23 Cr H1 FY 2025 -2026 INR 217 Cr INR 51 Cr INR 21 Cr Mr. Pramod Ranjan, Managing Director & CEO, Oriental Hotels Ltd. said, “In Q2 FY27, OHL reported an operating revenue of INR 117 crores driven by an 9% growth in RevPAR. The Company achieved an operating EBITDA of INR 27 crores and a PAT of INR 12 crores. For the first half of the year, operating revenue stood at INR 228 crores, operating EBITDA of INR 50 crores and PAT of INR 23 crores, a 10% growth over last year. Enabled by key asset upgradation in the OHL portfolio, we are well positioned to deliver a strong performance in the coming quarters.” KEY HIGHLIGHTS • IHCL’s iconic brand Taj is ranked as India’s Strongest Brand 2026 and World’s Strongest Luxury Hotel Brand 2026 as per Brand Finance-UK. OHL has 3 Taj branded hotels in its portfolio. • With a focus on promoting Environmental Stewardship under IHCL’s ESG+ framework of Paathya, OHL hotels renewable energy consumption stood at 61% About Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) Oriental Hotels Limited (OHL) is an associate company of The Indian Hotels Company Limited (IHCL). The company has seven hotels – Taj Coromandel, Chennai Taj Fisherman’s Cove Resort & Spa, Chennai Taj Malabar Resort & Spa, Cochin, Vivanta Coimbatore, Vivanta Mangalore; Gateway Madurai and Gateway Coonoor.

corporate_announcements.pdf_extracted_text: Classification | REGULATORS IRC: F48: 158: 356 :2026 15th October 2026 The Manager, The Manager, National Stock Exchange of India Ltd, BSE Limited, Exchange Plaza, 5th Floor, Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, Plot No. C-1, ‘G’ Block, Dalal Street, Bandra- Kurla Complex, Mumbai – 400001 Bandra (East), Mumbai – 400051 Scrip Code: KARURVYSYA Scrip Code: 590003 Dear Sir/Madam, Sub: Intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015 – Press Release ******* Pursuant to Regulation 30 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, please find attached Press Release made by the Bank titled – “Karur Vysya Bank announces Financial Results for the Quarter ended 30th September 2026.” Kindly take the same on record. Yours faithfully, Srinivasarao Maddirala Company Secretary & Compliance Officer Encl: As above Classification | INTERNAL PRESS RELEASE 15th Oct 2026 KARUR VYSYA BANK ANNOUNCES FINANCIAL RESULTS FOR THE QUARTER ENDED 30TH Sep 2026. Highlights: ❖ Total Business up by 17.96% YOY and 5.48% for the quarter. ❖ Deposits up by 15.96% YOY and 4.52% for the quarter. ❖ Advances grew at 20.35% YOY and 6.60% for the quarter. ❖ Advances under RAM grew at 20.00% YOY and 6% for the quarter. ❖ CASA up by 15.41% YOY, 4.40% QOQ, CASA ratio stood at 27.52%. ❖ PPOP up by 23.86% YOY ❖ NIM at 4.34%, increase by 28 bps YOY. ❖ Commission and Fee income up by 11% YOY. ❖ Cost to Income Ratio for the period is at 40.53%. ❖ Net Profit is increased by 40.91 % on YOY and stood at Rs.1543 crore ❖ ROA at 2.10% for the quarter. ❖ ROE at 20.47% for the quarter. ❖ GNPA at 0.69%, NNPA at 0.18%. ❖ Capital adequacy ratio (CRAR) stood at 18.61% with CET 1 ratio of 17.98% Classification | INTERNAL Mr. Ramesh Babu B, Managing Director & CEO, The Karur Vysya Bank said, We are pleased to report that our key performance indicators are broadly in line with the guidance shared earlier. The business growth has been balanced and broad-based, with sustained performance across our three key priorities: growth, profitability, and asset quality. This reflects the continued strength and resilience of our operating performance since the year's outset. The bank’s total business reached Rs 2,39,712 crore, reflecting our continued growth momentum in the second, with an overall business increase of 5% (QOQ) and a year-on- year growth of 18%. Our Advances stood at Rs 1,11,589 crore, representing a growth of 7% (QOQ), while deposits increased to Rs 1,28,123 crore, achieving a (QOQ) growth rate of 4%. Building on its strong performance, the Bank recorded its highest profit of Rs.788 crore . While we remain mindful of the evolving operating environment, our focus remains steady on prudent calibrated growth, operational efficiency, customer centricity, and disciplined risk management. This approach gives us confidence in delivering sustainable value to all stakeholders.

Dear Sir/Madam, Pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para B of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, we are pleased to inform you that Aaron Industries Limited has introduced Fire-Rated Steel Doors as a new product under the Commercial and Industrial Fire Door Systems category, effective October 15, 2026. The Company's Swing Metal Fire Doors have received a Fire Certificate from Gujarat Test House, Ahmedabad, with a fire-resistance rating of 120 minutes in accordance with IS 3614:2021. The product is designed for use in passageways, corridors and other designated fire-safety applications in commercial, industrial and institutional buildings, subject to applicable building codes and certified product specifications. The introduction of this product represents an expansion of the Company's existing product portfolio and reflects its continued focus on product development, manufacturing capabilities and the introduction of value-added products to address evolving customer requirements. The requisite details pursuant to Regulation 30 read with Para B of Part A of Schedule III of the SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulations, 2015, and the SEBI Master Circular No. HO/49/14/14(7)2025-CFD-POD2/I/3762/2026 dated January 30, 2026, are enclosed herewith as Annexure-A. Soni Company Secretary and Compliance Officer Membership No. FCS7063 Encl.: As above Zydus Sunshine Lifesciences signs agreement with Board of Investment, Sri Lanka to establish a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in Sri Lanka Ahmedabad, India, 15 October, 2026 Dear Sir/Madam, We wish to inform you that Zydus Sunshine Lifesciences (Pvt) Ltd, the proposed joint venture between Zydus Lifesciences Limited (Zydus) and Sunshine Healthcare, part of Sunshine Holdings PLC, signed an agreement with the Board of Investment of Sri Lanka on 13 October 2026 to establish a pharmaceutical manufacturing facility in the BOI zone in Horana, Sri Lanka. For H1 FY27, revenue from operations increased 45.1% to ₹3,131.9 crore, EBITDA grew 47.4% to ₹1,105.0 crore, and profit after tax (PAT) rose 79.1% to ₹762.3 crore. As at 30 September 2026, the Company had installed annual capacity of approximately 10.3 GW in modules and 2.94 GW in TOPCon solar cells. Emmvee is a leading integrated module and cell manufacturer. Capacity expansion and integration Emmvee is progressing with its 6 GW integrated TOPCon module and cell manufacturing expansion. Commercial sales and utilisation are expected to ramp up progressively following commissioning. The Company also plans phased backward integration into 9 GW of ingot and wafer manufacturing, comprising 5 GW in FY29 and a further 4 GW in FY30. This remains subject to regulatory clarity on ALMM III implementation timelines and market conditions. The estimated capital expenditure for the proposed ingot and wafer project is ₹5,000-5,500 crore, expected to be funded largely through internal accruals.
